body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Dual Electronics announced its new multimedia head unit 'XDVD9101' during CES 2009. This powerful multimedia entertainment center brings together all of today's favorite music and video sources, allowing drivers to enjoy them through a friendly, easy-to-operate user interface and generous 7-inch LCD screen.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
